title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Role: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Product Salary : Flexible + equity Are you an engineer who loves building with LLMs, but also wants to stay close to customers and the product decisions behind what gets built? If so, this could be worth a look. I’m working with an early-stage AI company building intelligent software for a large, operationally complex industry. Their platform automates time-consuming, manual workflows - from customer communications and coordination through to scheduling, compliance and operational administration. This isn’t a traditional Product Manager role, and it isn’t a conventional engineering role either. It sits closer to a Forward Deployed Engineer: someone who can take a messy customer problem, work out what will genuinely solve it, and build the solution directly. The team builds product natively with LLM tools, particularly Claude Code. Rather than writing tickets and handing work over, Product works closely with Engineering to build, test and iterate directly, with a real focus on quality, speed and customer impact. You’ll join a small product team at an important point in the journey. The product is live with a growing base of trial customers, with strong early conversion, alongside a second major enterprise client now in trial. The team is scaling quickly, with a clear opportunity to shape the product as it moves from early traction into wider commercial rollout. What they’re looking for A strong software-engineering foundation, ideally with around 3–5 years’ experience and a technical degree Someone who has moved towards product, customers or commercial problems without losing the instinct to build Genuine hands-on experience building with LLM tooling - ideally Claude Code Evidence of taking an ambiguous problem through to a working product, prototype or live customer solution Strong product judgement: able to make sensible calls on what to build, what to leave out and how to get to value quickly Comfortable working directly with customers and turning imperfect feedback into a clear technical or product solution High standards for quality, with the curiosity and rigour to investigate why something is not working Happy in a small, in-person, high-ownership team where pace is high and the work is visible Startup, founder or Forward Deployed Engineering experience would be particularly relevant This is a chance to join early, work alongside a highly technical, LLM-native product team, and help define a genuinely modern way of building product - close to customers, close to the code, and with real ownership from day one. Please apply now for more information on the role and company!
